_comment: S3432 - this product's declaration against the ICON-SET vocabulary (contracts catalog, iconography/vocabulary.jsonl). Read by scripts/quality/assert-icon-contract.ps1. The vocabulary's own ref/states/levels/variants already map every drawable they name; this file adds only what the vocabulary cannot know. Each 'glyphs' entry says a product drawable draws an existing meaning under another file name (a plate form, a notification silhouette, a tile copy) - never a new meaning, which is a vocabulary amendment first (ICON-SET rule 5). A key naming a Compose Material vector (Icons.<Style>.<Name>, Default read as Filled, AutoMirrored dropped; S3482) maps that vector wherever a module draws it. A key prefixed 'wear:' applies to the watch only, 'app_v2:' to the phone only. A drawable left out of both lists is a finding until it is mapped or the vocabulary gains its meaning.
